recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，一個骨髓顆粒（particle）邊緣聚集了約十個大型巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），數量明顯增加，其餘造血細胞與脂肪空泡正常，這種「巨核細胞增多但周邊血小板低」的組合支持免疫性血小板低下症（ITP）。
features: Increased megakaryocytes, including a cluster of about ten at the edge of a marrow particle
Megakaryocytes appear relatively small to medium sized with dense cytoplasm at this magnification
Cellular marrow particle with interspersed fat vacuoles
Trilineage hematopoietic cells in the trails without an obvious blast population
Few free platelets in the background
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows a cellular particle with interspersed fat spaces. Megakaryocytes are increased, with a cluster of approximately ten megakaryocytes along the particle edge and additional megakaryocytes in the adjacent trails. The surrounding hematopoietic elements show no obvious blast population, and few platelets are seen in the background. Detailed megakaryocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with increased peripheral platelet destruction such as immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes (micromegakaryocytes, separated or hypolobated nuclei) and dysplasia in other lineages, which require high-power review.

ddx.dx: Myeloproliferative neoplasm (e.g., essential thrombocythemia, early PMF)
ddx.vs: MPNs have increased large or bizarre, clustered megakaryocytes with normal or high platelet counts rather than thrombocytopenia.
Production failure shows reduced or absent megakaryocytes, the opposite of this image.
Inherited disorders usually show normal megakaryocyte numbers with giant platelets on smear and a lifelong or familial history.
